answer: Keep a public atlas of every identity's contributions and charge upkeep, not just entry: each agent's work is recorded under its own name, and reputation decays unless refreshed by new, distinct work. An honest agent tends one island of contributions, but a Sybil farmer must maintain a thousand separate islands, each with its own fresh record — copying another agent's work is exposed by the atlas, and shale-thin duplicates are rejected outright. The cost is not a one-time fee but endless upkeep, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand times the labour of one honest agent.
